The '''Lianorm Raceway''' was a 10.5 mile-long [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] course on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Its terrain consisted of [[Grass/Legends|grass]] and [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]], offering several obstacles to [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]] along its sinuous path. Although Podracing was banned on many worlds, Naboo hosted championship events on the raceway during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At one point, the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was considered the favorite to win on the track.

==Characteristics==
The Lianorm Raceway, located<ref name="RR" /> on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], was a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] track set up on a terrain composed of [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] and [[Grass/Legends|grass]], where creatures such as [[Shaak/Legends|shaaks]] and [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]-like [[Diet/Legends|herbivores]] could be found in small enclosures. The raceway was located at the edge of a large body of [[Water/Legends|water]], and a head statue<ref name="RR" /> linked to Naboo's ancient [[Elders (Naboo)/Legends|Elders]]<ref name="inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> could be found at the site.<ref name="RR" />

The sinuous course had a total length of 10.5 miles, possessed two shortcuts, and featured a small water fountain and several sets of stands for the public around the finishing line,<ref name="RR" /> all built in the classical Naboo style of architecture,<ref name="visual">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> with some of the buildings covered with a domed roof. Although most of the terrain was clear for passage, ponds, rocks and groves were common sights in the middle of the track. A map for the speedway detailed some of its features, while also containing annotations in a [[Huttese (standard writing system)/Legends|Huttese script]] and circles around certain curves along the path.<ref name="RR" />

==History==
[[File:Lianorm_stands.png|thumb|250px|Top view of the Lianorm Raceway stands at full capacity]]
Although the sport of [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] was already banned from most civilized [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="cross">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> and was considered extremely dangerous for [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to compete in,<ref name="TIP1">{{SW|url=news/this-is-podracing-sports-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-part-1|series=Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|text=Part 1: This Is Podracing|nolive=1}}</ref> Naboo still hosted Podraces during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="RR" /> which was the ruling government of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> The Lianorm Raceway was a venue for events such as championships, regular races and one-on-one competitions. Racers sometimes competed from the end to the start of the track.<ref name="RR" />

The [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] Human and later [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]<ref name="TPM" /> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was at one point listed as the track favorite. Other Podracers who may have raced in the course include<ref name="RR" /> the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]]<ref name="DBseb">{{DB|character|sebulba|Sebulba}}</ref> [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]],<ref name="RR" /> the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]]<ref name="DBclegg">{{DB|character|cleggholdfast|Holdfast, Clegg}}</ref> [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]],<ref name="RR" /> the [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]]<ref name="DBteemto">{{DB|character|teemtopagalies|Pagalies, Teemto}}</ref> [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]],<ref name="RR" /> and the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]]<ref name="DBratts">{{DB|character|rattstyerell|Tyerell, Ratts}}</ref> [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]].<ref name="RR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lianorm Raceway was only mentioned in ''[[Racer Rush]]'', a Podracing online game available at [[StarWars.com]]. The game was launched as a supplement to the theatrical re-release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] in [[Wikipedia:3D film|3D]], which, along with the portrayal of a young Anakin, indicates that game itself is set during the [[Rise of the Empire era]].<ref name="RR" /> It is unclear if the track is related to the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]] of Naboo.
